paragraphs: The Velar D300 is the 6-cylinder diesel option in the Range Rover Velar range, using the Ingenium AJ300D. It's a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel engine fitted to the Velar from its launch in 2017 to the present day. The D300 sits above the 4-cylinder diesel variants (D180, D200, D240, D250) and below the petrol and PHEV options in the Velar engine line-up.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D engines for every Velar D300 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the Velar D300 from 2017 to the present (L560 generation). Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
